paragraphs.text: Catalyst Cat-X achieved 88.5% Faradaic efficiency for CO2 reduction at 25 °C and pH 7.4 compared with 62.0% for the baseline Cu electrode.
Electrochemical tests were performed in 0.1 M KHCO3 electrolyte using a 5 mg catalyst loading over 24 h (n = 3 independent electrodes).
Long-term durability was evaluated for 24 h; industrial-scale flow-cell stability beyond 100 h was not tested in this study.

tables.text: Table 1: Cat-X Faradaic efficiency 88.5% vs baseline Cu 62.0% at 25 °C, 5 mg loading.
footnotes: *All measurements recorded at pH 7.4 in 0.1 M KHCO3; electrodes with leakage > 5% were excluded.
